answer: Saffron-gated traffic shaping. Each identity must maintain a sustained request rhythm whose inter-arrival jitter matches a cipher-seeded profile issued at registration; enforcement checks rolling-window variance, not totals. Fresh identities expire at dawn unless they complete a full ramp period of consistent pacing, so mass-created agents can't burst. Attacker cost: one dedicated traffic-shaping slot per identity for the ramp duration, serialized—parallel sybils fail variance checks.
